subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 1 – Lesson 6: English in action – Making arrangements
outcomes: Invite a friend: Do you want to play football tomorrow morning?
Say no politely and suggest another time.
Make an arrangement: Let's meet at quarter to five in the park.

tf.s: Ryan and Alex arrange to meet at quarter to five.
tf.why: Yes! They meet at quarter to five.

tf.s: Ryan goes swimming on Friday mornings.
tf.why: Correct! So he can't play then.

tf.s: Alex always visits his aunt on Saturdays.
tf.why: Right! So he is not free on Saturday morning.

tf.s: 'Sorry, I can't.' is a way to say yes.
tf.why: 'Sorry, I can't.' is a polite way to say no.

tf.s: 'Let's meet in the park.' is a suggestion.

tf.why: Yes! We use 'What about ...?' to suggest.

tf.s: We say: Do you want play football?
tf.why: We need to: Do you want to play football?

tf.s: 'I'm not free' means you have time to play.
tf.why: I'm not free means you are busy.

tf.s: 'See you then!' is a way to end an arrangement.
tf.why: Yes! We say it when the plan is ready.

boxes.q: What time do the boys meet?
boxes.why: They meet at quarter to five.

boxes.q: Why can't Ryan play on Friday morning?
boxes.why: Ryan goes swimming on Friday mornings.

boxes.q: Why can't Alex play on Saturday morning?
boxes.why: Alex always visits his aunt on Saturdays.
See you then! closes the plan.
Let's meet at quarter to five in the park.

o: Do you want to play football?
mcq.why: Do you want to ...? is an invitation.
Sorry, I'm not free. says no nicely.

mcq.q: Who always visits his aunt on Saturdays?
mcq.why: Alex visits his aunt on Saturdays.

mcq.q: Your friend asks: 'Do you want to go to the park?' You are busy. What do you say?
o: Sorry, I can't. I'm not free.
mcq.why: Say sorry and that you are not free.

mcq.q: Order the words: you / do / want / to / tennis / play / ?
o: Do you want to play tennis?
You do want to tennis play?
Do want you to play tennis?
Do you to want play tennis?

mcq.q: Choose a suggestion with a time and a place.
o: Let's meet at half past four in the park.
mcq.why: It has Let's, a time and a place.

mcq.q: Why can't Ryan play football on Friday morning?
o: He goes swimming on Friday mornings.

mcq.q: A and B are both free on Friday at six o'clock. What can they do?
o: Go to the cinema together on Friday at six.
mcq.why: They are both free, so they can make a plan.

mcq.q: What is the correct order of an arrangement?
mcq.why: First invite, then refuse, suggest a new time and agree.
